Title: Leaderboard request params
PreConditions: Instructor is authenticated and analytics-service is reachable
Steps: 1. Call analyticsApi.getLeaderboard with the defaults 2. Call it with the DashboardPage arguments 3. Call it with ALL_TIME
Expected: GET /api/analytics/leaderboard is issued with exactly {period;limit} = WEEKLY/10 then WEEKLY/5 then ALL_TIME/50

Title: Leaderboard envelope unwrapping
PreConditions: apiClient mocked to return a success envelope
Steps: Call analyticsApi.getLeaderboard('WEEKLY';5) and inspect the resolved value
Expected: The resolved value is the leaderboard array itself because ApiEnvelope.data is unwrapped

Title: Leaderboard error envelope
Expected: Rejects with an ApiError whose message is 'Forbidden'

Title: Leaderboard missing data
PreConditions: apiClient mocked to return success:true without a data field
Expected: Rejects with an ApiError instance rather than resolving undefined

Title: Grading stats read
Steps: Call examApi.getGradingStats() and inspect the recorded request and the resolved value
Expected: GET /api/exams/grading/stats is issued and pending/graded/oldestPendingSubmittedAt are unwrapped unchanged

Title: Grading stats 403 mapping
PreConditions: The caller token is not an instructor
Expected: Rejects with an ApiError carrying status 403 and message 'Forbidden'

Title: Dashboard main content and stat derivation
PreConditions: Instructor seeded in the auth store; exam/grading/leaderboard reads mocked at the module boundary
Steps: 1. Render DashboardPage 2. Wait for the exam list 3. Assert the heading; the KPI values; the per-exam pending link; the leaderboard initials; the four quick-action hrefs
TestData: 2 exams (1 proctored); grading stats pending=3 graded=12; queue with 2 rows for e-1; leaderboard with 1 row
Expected: h1 is 'Dashboard Giang vien'; the instructor name renders as an h2; the stat cards read 2 exams / 1 proctored / 3 pending / 12 graded; the e-1 row shows a '2 bai cho cham' link to /instructor/grading and the e-2 row shows 'Khong co bai cho cham'; the leaderboard initials are 'NV' for 'Nguyen Van A'; the quick-action links carry /instructor/courses/create and /instructor/grading and /instructor/ai-question and /instructor/analytics

Title: Dashboard empty states
PreConditions: Instructor seeded; every read returns an empty list
Steps: Render DashboardPage and wait for the no-exams copy
Expected: Renders 'Ban chi co bai thi nao'; the no-course-API and no-activity-API copy; and the 'Chua co du lieu' leaderboard empty state with no leaderboard list rendered

Title: Instructor dashboard route and guard and testids and console errors
PreConditions: Dev server on :3000; valid instructor storageState; all four page reads intercepted with page.route
Steps: 1. Open /instructor 2. Assert the URL is unchanged 3. Assert the data-testids 4. Assert the stat values 5. Assert the per-exam pending link href 6. Assert zero console errors
TestData: 2 exams (1 proctored); pending=3; graded=12; queue 2 rows for e-1; leaderboard 1 row
Expected: URL stays /instructor so the instructor guard passes with no redirect to /auth/login; instructor-dashboard-stats / -exam-list / -exam-item / -quick-actions / -leaderboard / -leaderboard-item are present; the KPI values read 2 / 1 / 3 / 12; the '2 bai cho cham' link points at /instructor/grading; zero console errors
